display.purpose: Page titles and the dashboard greeting; 26px under 640px.

title.purpose: Section and card titles; dialog titles step to 18px.

reading.purpose: Markdown on the study card (19-20px question, 17px answer) and editor preview.

body.purpose: Default 15px text; controls use 14px, compact controls 13px.

label.purpose: Muted sentence-case labels, hints and meta lines.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Resting outlined controls, panels, inputs, rating buttons.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Course-card hover and the study card.

shadows.name: shadow-pop
shadows.purpose: Floating layers: dialogs, menus, toasts, tooltips, drawer.

shadows.name: primary-bevel
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons and the Resume session button.

shadows.name: input-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focused inputs, with border set to primary.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Colour, border and shadow changes on controls; chevron rotation; switch thumb.

motion.name: pop-in

components.css: .ds-course { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 360px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e5e7eb); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(17 24 39 / 0.04); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #111827); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-course:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #d1d5db); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(17 24 39 / 0.04), 0 2px 8px rgb(17 24 39 / 0.04); } .ds-course-head { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-swatch { width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-top: 7px; border-radius: 3px; background: #14b8a6; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-course h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-course-head p, .ds-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #6b7280); } .ds-figs { display: flex; gap: 32px; margin: 16px 0 0; } .ds-figs div { display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; } .ds-figs dt { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #6b7280); } .ds-figs dd { margin: 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.25; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-figs .ds-due { color: var(--primary-text, #1d4ed8); } .ds-track { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 6px; margin: 16px 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--surface-3, #e8eaee); } .ds-track span { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #2563eb); } .ds-track .ds-track-due { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #2563eb) 38%, var(--surface-3, #e8eaee)); }

components.css: .ds-rate { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; width: 180px; min-height: 72px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e5e7eb); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--text, #111827); text-align: left; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(17 24 39 / 0.04); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-rate:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rc) 55%, var(--border, #e5e7eb)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rc) 6%, var(--surface, #fff)); } .ds-rate:focus-visible { border-color: var(--rc); outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #3b82f6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rate:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-rate-row { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-rate-icon { display: flex; width: 20px; height: 20px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 5px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rc) 14%, transparent); color: var(--rc); } .ds-rate-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-rate-meaning { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.375; color: var(--muted, #6b7280); } .ds-kbd { margin-left: auto; display: inline-flex; min-width: 1.4rem; justify-content: center; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e5e7eb); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--surface-2, #f3f4f6); color: var(--muted, #6b7280); font: 400 11px/18px 'JetBrains Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border, #e5e7eb); }

narrative.overview:
Recall is the category standard for a study app, played straight and executed at Linear-grade precision. It is a neutral workspace: a white sidebar on a cool grey ground, near-black ink, one blue accent, 1px hairlines and near-flat surfaces. Nothing in the chrome performs. The loudest thing on any screen is either the number that tells the student what to do next (cards due, streak) or, on the study screen, the card itself with its math and code.

Density is desk density: 15px body, 13px labels, 32–36px controls, tabular figures everywhere a number can move. Hierarchy comes from weight (500/600), size steps and the ink ramp (text, text-2, muted), not from colour or decoration. The keyboard is a first-class surface: shortcut keycaps sit inline next to the actions they trigger.

Two families of colour sit outside the neutral-plus-blue core and are fenced in. Rating colours (red, amber, blue, green) appear only where a rating is shown. Course colours are user data: a small square swatch or a tinted icon tile that identifies a course, never a fill for chrome. Light and dark themes are both complete token sets, not inversions.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grey ground, white surfaces, one blue accent.
1px hairline borders do the structural work; shadows are barely there at rest.
Inter with tabular numerals; weights 400/500/600 only.
8–12px radii on controls and panels, 16px on the study card alone.
Keyboard hints rendered as mono keycaps beside their actions.
Motivation from real data (counts, streak bars, on-track bars), never from badges or celebration.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is reserved for primary actions, selection, due counts and progress. If it is not one of those, it is grey.

rules.name: The Rating Fence Rule
rules.body: The four rating colours appear only where a rating is shown or rated. Never borrow amber for a warning or green for success from the rating set; use the semantic tokens.

rules.name: The Course Swatch Rule
rules.body: Course colours identify a course through an 8–10px square swatch (3px radius) or a 15% tinted icon tile. They never fill buttons, headers or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every count, percentage and duration uses tabular figures so values do not jitter as they change.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400, 500 and 600 only (650 inside rendered Markdown headings and strong). No bold 700 in the chrome.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px borders, never with shadow. A shadow that is visible at rest on a non-floating element is too strong.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards step from soft to card shadow and from border to border-strong on hover; nothing translates upward. Pressed buttons move down 1px.

dos: Do keep one primary button per view region; everything else is secondary or ghost.
Do use primary-text, not primary, whenever blue is text.
Do draw structure with 1px hairlines (border) and reserve shadow-lg for floating layers.
Do set every changing number in tabular figures.
Do show keyboard shortcuts as mono keycaps beside their actions.
Do define every new colour in both the `:root` and `.dark` token sets.
Do show progress only from real data: counts, streak, activity bars, on-track bars.
donts: Don't use rating colours outside rating contexts, or semantic colours for ratings.
Don't fill chrome with course colours; a course is identified by its swatch or tinted icon tile.
Don't add mascots, confetti, XP bars, cartoon badges or celebratory gamification.
Don't return to the indigo-on-cream soft-card look this system replaced.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels or eyebrows above headings; labels are 13px sentence case.
Don't use weights above 600 in the interface chrome.
Don't hardcode hex values in components; reference the tokens.
